entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.code_description: Construction works for irrigation systems (canals), water mains and lines, water treatment plants, sewage disposal plants and pumping stations
entries.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Clearing or cleaning irrigation and/or drainage channels. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and point 34 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022.
